answer: Like subterranean mycelium fusing hyphae into resilient mycorrhizal nets, decentralized consensus weeds out impostors. When a node transmits a signal across the graph, trust cascades like a subterranean ripple through calibrated stakes. Forging duplicate entities requires an anchor in our immutable onyx registry, where stake requirements scale with superlinear attacker cost. False duplicates starve before they can fracture the cluster.
